chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 求财交易以财为主，发动临身必取；卦无财或落空，一切营谋不行

rule.yi: 求财做买卖，以财为主；财发动而临身，钱财一定拿得到；卦里没有财，或者财落空，一切谋求都靠不住。
rule.en: In seeking wealth and trade Wealth is the chief; Wealth moving and on the Body, the money is sure to be taken; if the hexagram has no Wealth, or Wealth falls void, no scheme of any kind can be relied on.

yi: 财发动而临身，钱财一定拿得到；
卦里如果没有财，或者财落空，
en: In seeking wealth and trade, Wealth is the chief;
Wealth moving and on the Body, the money is sure to be taken;
if the hexagram has no Wealth, or Wealth falls void,
no scheme of any kind can be relied on.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 财爻持世或克世，一买一卖利百倍；克身又得青龙扶，积玉堆金

rule.yi: 财爻持世，或克世，一买一卖，利润百倍；克身又有青龙扶助，金玉堆积得算不清。
rule.en: Wealth on the Self or controlling it brings a hundredfold profit on one purchase and one sale; controlling the Body as well and supported by the Azure Dragon, gold and jade pile up beyond counting.

en: Wealth on the Self, or controlling it:
one purchase and one sale, a hundredfold profit;
controlling the Body as well and supported by the Azure Dragon:
heaped gold and jade beyond counting.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 财爻外动较难，财在内兴人送至；外生内、应生世，财轻也容易

rule.yi: 财爻在外卦发动，比较艰难；财在内卦兴旺，人会把钱送上门；外卦生内卦、应生世，即使财轻也容易。
rule.en: A Wealth line moving in the outer trigram is harder; Wealth thriving in the inner trigram, people bring the money to you; the outer generating the inner and the Other generating the Self, even if Wealth is light it is easy.

yi: 财爻在外卦发动，比较艰难；
财在内卦兴旺，人会把钱送上门；
en: A Wealth line moving in the outer trigram is harder;
Wealth thriving in the inner trigram, people bring the money to you;
the outer generating the inner and the Other generating the Self:
even if Wealth is light, it is easy.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 应克世、世克身，有财难成；世应比和身安，资财平稳无忧滞

rule.yi: 应克世、世克身，就算有财，终究难以成就；世应比和、卦身又安稳，资财平稳，没有忧愁阻滞。
rule.en: The Other controlling the Self and the Self controlling the Body: even with Wealth it is hard to bring about in the end; Self and Other in harmony and the Body at ease: the funds are steady, with no worry or delay.

yi: 就算有财，终究难以成就；
资财平稳，没有忧愁阻滞。
en: The Other controlling the Self and the Self controlling the Body:
even with Wealth it is hard to bring about in the end;
Self and Other in harmony and the Body at ease:
the funds are steady, with no worry or delay.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 财生库旺聚钱财；财休囚货贱如尘宜措置，财旺相货贵如金宜乘早弃

rule.yi: 财得生、库又旺，钱财聚拢；子孙动、青龙交，正称心意。财爻落在废、休、囚，货贱如尘土，宜于买进；财爻旺相，货贵如金，有货必须趁早出手。
rule.en: Wealth generated and its store strong, money gathers; Output moving and the Dragon joining, all as one wishes. The Wealth line abandoned, resting or trapped, the goods are as cheap as dust and right to buy in; the Wealth line strong, the goods are as dear as gold and whoever has goods must sell early.

yi: 财得生、库又旺，钱财聚拢；
子孙动、青龙交，正合心意；
货贱得像尘土，宜于买进；
en: Wealth generated and its store strong, money gathers;
Output moving and the Dragon joining, all as one wishes;
if the Wealth line is abandoned, resting or trapped,
the goods are as cheap as dust and right to buy in;
the Wealth line strong, the goods are dear as gold,
and whoever has goods must sell early.

note.yi: 「宜措置」按字面读作适合置办（买进），《火珠林》此句作「应措置」。
note.en: 'Fit to arrange' is read as fit to stock up (buy in); the Huozhu Lin has 'should arrange' here.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 财爻不动平安，遇杀逢空破费；外鬼牵玄武，官灾盗贼；劫杀临身克身，忌暗昧

rule.yi: 财爻不动，钱财平安；遇凶杀、逢空，终究破费。外卦的官鬼把玄武牵来，官灾、盗贼，重重后悔。劫杀临身又克身，暗昧私下的事必须忌讳。
rule.en: Wealth still, the money is safe; meeting an ill star or void, in the end it is spent. A Pressure outside bringing in the Dark Tortoise: official trouble and thieves, regrets on regrets. The Robbery star on the Body and controlling it: secret and shady dealings must be avoided.

yi: 外卦的官鬼把玄武牵来，
暗昧私下的事，一定要忌讳。
en: Wealth still, the money is safe;
meeting an ill star or void, in the end it is spent;
a Pressure outside bringing in the Dark Tortoise:
official trouble and thieves, regrets on regrets;
the Robbery star on the Body and controlling it:
secret and shady dealings must be avoided.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 财爻驿马木神扶，成交遇贵；兄弟螣蛇是悔神；忌朱雀当头

rule.yi: 财爻带驿马、又有木神扶助，买卖成交，还能遇到贵人；兄弟和螣蛇是招悔的神，财怕散失，身怕不顺；不要再让朱雀当头，官司口舌就会牵连上来。
rule.en: Wealth on the Post Horse and helped by a Wood spirit: the deal is made and a noble is met besides; Peer and the Coiling Snake are spirits of regret, Wealth fearing to be scattered and lost and the Body fearing distress; do not let the Vermilion Bird head it, or lawsuits and quarrels follow.

yi: 财爻带驿马、又有木神扶助，
买卖成交，还能遇到贵人；
兄弟和螣蛇是招悔的神，
官司口舌就会牵连上来。
en: Wealth on the Post Horse and helped by a Wood spirit:
the deal is made and a noble is met besides;
Peer and the Coiling Snake are spirits of regret:
Wealth fears being scattered and lost, the Body fears distress;
and do not let the Vermilion Bird head it,
or lawsuits and quarrels follow.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 兄弟化财须防圈套；妻财化兄弟折本伤财；子孙化财、财化子孙利多；青龙水上来登山涉海饶利

rule.yi: 兄弟化成财，虽有财，要忌落入别人的圈套；折本伤财，只因妻财化成兄弟；子孙化成财，利润宜多，财化成子孙更不是小利；青龙落在水上，登山涉海多得利润。
rule.en: Peer turning into Wealth, though there is money, take care not to fall into another's trap; capital and money are lost only because Wealth turned into Peer; Output turning into Wealth brings large profit, and Wealth turning into Output is better still; with the Azure Dragon on Water, climbing mountains and crossing seas brings much profit.

yi: 千万要忌讳落入别人的圈套；
只因为妻财化成了兄弟；
财化成子孙，更不是小利；
en: Peer turning into Wealth, though there is money,
take great care not to fall into another's trap;
why are capital and money lost?
only because Wealth turned into Peer;
Output turning into Wealth, profit should be large;
Wealth turning into Output is better still;
and if the Azure Dragon comes upon Water,
climbing mountains and crossing seas brings much profit.

note.yi: 「圈圆」是「圈圈」（圈套）的另一种写法，周易尚占作「圈圚」。「水上来」译作落在水爻上，是照字面取的读法。
note.en: 'Quan yuan' is another way of writing the word for a trap; the Zhouyi Shangzhan has yet another variant. 'Comes upon Water' is read literally as falling on a Water line.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 勾陈交鬼必淹留，行货临官被贼偷；妻财化官鬼获利被官收；行商坐贾忌官爻临本库

rule.yi: 勾陈、官鬼发动，必被耽搁滞留；运货时官鬼临身，货被贼偷；妻财忽然化成官鬼，虽然获利，却被官府收去；行商坐贾经营钱财，切忌官爻落在本库上，不是官司送来祸事，就一定被贼偷走。
rule.en: Hook Earth and Pressure moving, you are surely held up; carrying goods with Pressure on it, thieves steal them; Wealth suddenly turning into Pressure, though profit is made the officials take it; for travelling merchants and shopkeepers, the Pressure line falling on its own store is above all to be avoided: it is either a lawsuit bringing trouble or thieves who surely steal it away.

yi: 勾陈、官鬼发动，必定被耽搁滞留；
运货时官鬼临身，货被贼偷；
en: Hook Earth and Pressure moving, you are surely held up;
carrying goods with Pressure on it, thieves steal them;

yi: 虽然获利，却被官府收去；
en: If Wealth suddenly turns into Pressure,
though profit is made the officials take it;
travelling merchants and shopkeepers who deal in money
must beware of the Pressure line falling on its own store;
if it is not a lawsuit bringing trouble,
then thieves surely steal it away.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 地头克身，事未周全，阴爻主女人滞留；身爻克地头，满载荣归

rule.yi: 地头（所到之地）克身，事情没办周全，阴爻则是女人把你留住；身爻克地头，就能满船载宝、荣耀而归。
rule.en: The place you go to controlling the Body, matters are not fully done, and a yin line means a woman keeps you; the Body line controlling the place brings you home in glory with a boat full of treasure.

yi: 地头克身，事情没办周全；
如果是阴爻，一定是女人把你留住；
en: The place controlling the Body, matters are not fully done;
if it is a yin line, it is surely a woman who keeps you;

yi: 满船载着宝物荣耀而归的，
en: Those who come home in glory with a boat full of treasure
do so because the Body line controls the place.

note.yi: 「世未周」的「世」，《周易尚占》作「事未周」，读作事情没办周全。
note.en: The Zhouyi Shangzhan has 'matters not fully done' where this text has 'the Self not fully done'; it is read as matters not fully done.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 何日得钱财：应在身、财生旺之日；如乾以木为财，亥卯日为准

rule.yi: 想问钱财哪一天得到：应在卦身和财爻生旺的日子；比如乾宫以木为财，就以亥、卯的日子为准。
rule.en: To ask on what day the money is got: it answers on a day when the Body and Wealth are born or strong; for instance, if the Qian palace takes Wood as its Wealth, the days Hai and Mao are the standard.

yi: 应在卦身和财爻生旺的日子；
en: To ask on what day the money is got:
it answers on a day when the Body and Wealth are born or strong;
for instance, if the Qian palace takes Wood as its Wealth,
the days Hai and Mao are the standard.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 世应是财求易得，卦无财少准凭；财化鬼凶、鬼化财吉；财落空亡难把捉，遇二杀贼侵

rule.yi: 世应是财，求就容易得到；卦里没有财，就少有把握。财爻化成官鬼是凶象，官鬼化成财一定是吉神。财落在空亡，难以把握；再遇二杀（劫杀、天贼杀），贼来相侵。
rule.en: The Self or the Other being Wealth, seeking is easily rewarded; with no Wealth in the hexagram there is little to go on. Wealth turning into Pressure is an ill sign, and Pressure turning into Wealth is surely an auspicious spirit. Wealth fallen into Void is hard to seize, and if the two killers (the Robbery star and the Heavenly Thief star) are also met, thieves encroach.

yi: 世应是财，求就容易得到；
卦里如果没有财，就少有把握。
官鬼化成财，一定是吉神。
如果再遇二杀，贼来相侵。
en: The Self or the Other being Wealth, seeking is easily rewarded;
if the hexagram has no Wealth, there is little to go on.
Wealth turning into Pressure is an ill sign;
Pressure turning into Wealth is surely an auspicious spirit.
Wealth fallen into Void is hard to seize;
and if the two killers are also met, thieves encroach.
The two killers:
are the Robbery star and the Heavenly Thief star.

note.yi: 「二杀」这一句小注，《卜筮大全》直接排在诗后，《火珠林》排成括号里的注；这里按注文处理，归在旧注名下（注者不详）。
note.en: The small note on the 'two killers' is set straight after the verse in the Bushi Daquan and in brackets in the Huozhu Lin; here it is treated as commentary and attributed to the old commentary (author unknown).

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 财爻在外动难求，在内兴易觅；世克财休开口，财来克世得千金

rule.yi: 难求的，怕财爻在外卦发动；容易求到的，是财在内卦兴旺。世如果克财，别开口去求；财来克世，能得千金。
rule.en: Hard to get is a Wealth line moving in the outer trigram; easy to find is Wealth thriving in the inner; if the Self controls Wealth, do not open your mouth to ask; Wealth coming to control the Self brings a thousand gold.

yi: 难求的，怕财爻在外卦发动；
容易求到的，是财在内卦兴旺；
世如果克财，别开口去求；
en: Hard to get, when the Wealth line moves in the outer trigram;
easy to find, when Wealth thrives in the inner;
if the Self controls Wealth, do not open your mouth to ask;
Wealth coming to control the Self brings a thousand gold.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 诸爻无财象，子动龙交亦可寻；世应合最吉，子孙合为福德；月德月建相扶，求财数倍

rule.yi: 各爻都没有财的象，子孙动、青龙交，也能求到；世应相合最吉，子孙来合就是福德；月德、月建来相扶，求财终究能得数倍。
rule.en: If none of the lines shows the image of Wealth, Output moving and the Dragon joining still lets you seek it; Self and Other combining is most auspicious, and Output combining is fortune and virtue; the Month's Virtue and the Month supporting it, seeking wealth surely brings several times the sum.

yi: 各爻如果都没有财的象，
子孙动、青龙交，也能求到；
en: If none of the lines shows the image of Wealth,
Output moving and the Dragon joining still lets you seek it;
Self and Other combining is most auspicious;
Output combining is fortune and virtue;
the Month's Virtue and the Month should support it,
and seeking wealth surely brings several times the sum.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 内为人、外为地头：人克地头有淹留；地头克人兼旺相，求财数倍收

rule.yi: 内卦是人，外卦是地头（去的地方）：人克地头，会被耽搁滞留；地头克人又旺相，若是求财，能收数倍。
rule.en: The inner is the person and the outer the place: the person controlling the place is held up; the place controlling the person and strong too, seeking wealth reaps several times.

yi: 内卦是人，外卦是地头（去的地方）；
人克地头，会被耽搁滞留；
en: The inner is the person and the outer the place;
the person controlling the place is held up;
the place controlling the person and strong too,
seeking wealth reaps several times.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 日辰克身货出手，财克地头贼相守；青龙发动最佳，阴阳得位财必有

rule.yi: 日辰克身，货可以出手；财克地头，有贼守着；青龙发动最好，阴阳爻得位，财一定有。
rule.en: The Day controlling the Body, the goods go out; Wealth controlling the place, thieves lie in wait; the Azure Dragon moving is best, and with yin and yang lines in their right places Wealth is sure to be had.

en: The Day controlling the Body, the goods go out;
Wealth controlling the place, thieves lie in wait;
the Azure Dragon moving is best;
with yin and yang lines in their right places, Wealth is sure to be had.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 外爻无气应克身、遇空亡忧病；土爻持世有阻隔，阴爻持世女人淹滞

rule.yi: 外卦的爻没有气、应又克身，若再遇空亡，要担心生病；土爻持世，怎么离得开；阴爻持世，主是阴人（女人）。小注：土爻持世主有阻隔，阴爻持世主被女人耽搁滞留。
rule.en: The outer lines without breath and the Other controlling the Body, and if void besides, fear illness; an Earth line on the Self, how can you get away; a yin line on the Self points to a woman. The note: an Earth line on the Self means obstruction, a yin line on the Self means being held up by a woman.

yi: 外卦的爻没有气、应又克身，
若再遇空亡，要担心生病；
阴爻持世，主是阴人（女人）。
en: The outer lines without breath and the Other controlling the Body,
and if void besides, fear illness;
an Earth line on the Self: how can you get away?
a yin line on the Self points to a woman.
An Earth line on the Self
means obstruction;
a yin line on the Self
means being held up by a woman.

units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade
units.title: 求财四句：父动艰难，鬼动灾；子旺财明得利，兄兴迟滞是非

rule.yi: 凡占卦问求财：父母动就艰难，官鬼动就有灾；子孙旺、财明现，一定得利；兄弟兴旺，迟滞和是非就来。
rule.en: Whoever casts to ask about money: Resource moving means hardship and Pressure moving means disaster; Output strong and Wealth showing, profit is sure; Peer rising, delay and quarrels come.

yi: 父母动就艰难，官鬼动就有灾；
子孙旺、财明现，一定得利；
兄弟兴旺，迟滞、是非就来。
en: Whoever casts to ask about money:
Resource moving means hardship, Pressure moving means disaster;
Output strong and Wealth showing, profit is sure;
Peer rising, delay and quarrels come.

units.chapter: 求财买卖章 附添人口
units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade, appendix on taking in people
units.title: 添人口：财明子旺可成；父发兄摇难永远；鬼爻发动祸相亲

rule.yi: 添人进口（买人）：要财明现，子孙旺、财兴旺，就可以成；父母发动、兄弟动摇，难以长久；官鬼发动，祸事相近。
rule.en: Taking in a person: Wealth must show; Output strong and Wealth thriving, it can be done; Resource or Peer moving, it will not last; Pressure moving, disaster draws near.

yi: 子孙旺、财兴旺，就可以成；
父母发动、兄弟动摇，难以长久；
en: To take in a person, Wealth must show;
Output strong and Wealth thriving, it can be done;
Resource or Peer moving, it will not last;
Pressure moving, disaster draws near.

units.chapter: 求财买卖章 附交易
units.chapter_en: Verse on seeking wealth and trade, appendix on dealings
units.title: 交易：子动财明大吉；兄鬼爻摇合不成；父兴费尽力气

rule.yi: 买卖和交易：子孙动、财明现，最吉；兄弟、官鬼爻动摇，合不成；父母兴旺，费尽千钧之力也办不成。
rule.en: For trade and dealings: Output moving and Wealth showing is greatly auspicious; Peer or Pressure lines stirring, the deal cannot be joined; Resource rising, all one's strength is spent for nothing.

yi: 兄弟、官鬼爻动摇，合不成；
父母兴旺，费尽千钧之力。
en: For trade and dealings,
Output moving and Wealth showing is greatly auspicious;
Peer or Pressure lines stirring, the deal cannot be joined;
Resource rising, all one's strength is spent for nothing.
